title: Benefits Open Enrollment Optimizer
description: Compare up to 3 employer health plans by expected annual cost (premium + estimated OOP), model HSA/FSA tax savings including FICA exemption for HSA, and calculate 401(k) match capture rate. All inputs user-supplied — zero embedded employer plan data.
data_vintage: 2025 IRS limits: HSA self-only $4,300 · HSA family $8,550 · FSA $3,300 · FSA carryover $660 · 401(k) $23,500 (IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-25 · IR-2024-285). Limits are user-editable; no employer plan data embedded.

expected_spend.description: Anticipated annual medical spend in USD (prescriptions, visits, procedures)

marginal_tax_rate_pct.description: Combined federal + state marginal income tax rate as a percentage

hsa_fsa_tax_savings.description: Total federal + FICA tax savings from HSA/FSA election

match_leave_on_table.description: Annual employer match dollars forfeited by under-contributing

match_capture_rate_pct.description: Percentage of max possible employer match being captured

mcp_tool_definition.name: optimize_benefits_enrollment
mcp_tool_definition.description: Compare up to 3 employer health plans on expected annual net cost, model HSA/FSA tax savings (including FICA exemption for HSA payroll deductions), and calculate 401(k) match capture rate. Returns a benefits_election_record AP2 mandate.

plans.description: Array of up to 3 health plan objects with premium, deductible, OOP max, coinsurance

expected_spend.description: Anticipated annual medical spend in USD

coverage_type.description: Who is covered under the plan

marginal_tax_rate_pct.description: Combined federal + state marginal rate for HSA/FSA savings calc

account_type.description: Tax-advantaged account type (HSA requires HDHP enrollment)

annual_salary.description: Annual gross salary for 401(k) match calculation

regulatory_citations: IRS Rev. Proc. 2024-25 — 2025 HSA contribution limits: self-only $4,300, family $8,550
IRS Publication 969 — Health Savings Accounts and other tax-favored health plans
IRC Section 125 — Cafeteria plan FICA exclusion for HSA and FSA payroll deductions
ACA Section 1302(c) — Out-of-pocket maximum limits (updated annually by HHS)
